title: SIC--Stark Twisted-Convolution Certificates: Dimensions Four, Five, Seven, and Eight
description: Reproducibility archive for two companion papers proving the formal Twisted Convolution Conjecture in dimensions four and five, the discriminant-32 dimension-seven stratum, and both admissible dimension-eight strata. The release contains manuscript sources and PDFs, exact PARI/GP and Python certificates, rigorous Arb enclosures, regression tests, and deterministic archive builders.
